name: Brunello Cucinelli (BC.IT)
teaser: Cucinelli trades at 15 times EBITDA, but after rent and boutique investment only 18% of it becomes free cash flow. Reduce at €87.80.
llms: Brunello Cucinelli is an Italian luxury house (cashmere and understated clothing, 141 own boutiques) valued at 15.2 times 2026E EBITDA before rent, but only about 18% of that EBITDA becomes free cash flow after rent, capital spending and tax. The ten year cash flow model after lease payments gives a Base of EUR 39.63 and the multiple of 2027 EBITDA gives EUR 82.89, a 71% method gap. Bear EUR 37.86, Base EUR 56.93, Bull EUR 71.78. Verdict reduce at EUR 87.80, maximum buy price EUR 32.74.
